programme.desc: Sob crescente pressão política, o GBI e a Procuradora-Adjunta Marion Alba correm contra o tempo para resgatar uma criança raptada, ao mesmo tempo que descobrem segredos obscuros que podem abalar as suas noções pré-concebidas sobre as forças de segurança. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Will Trent T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma disputa dentro de um negócio familiar leva a múltiplos envenenamentos, puxando Will e Faith para uma teia emaranhada de segredos e intrigas corporativas. Entretanto, Angie, ansiosa por voltar à polícia, faz uma descoberta em Waldorf Estates. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Will Trent T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Enquanto a equipa investiga um caso complexo de espionagem, traições e identidade trocada, Amanda ajuda Sunny a adaptar-se à sua nova vida e escola. Entretanto, Ormewood debate-se com o seu divórcio, enquanto os sentimentos de Will por Marion ficam mais fortes. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Will Trent T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Quando Evelyn Mitchell regressa à cidade, as coisas mudam rapidamente quando ela se envolve no caso de uma moeda rara roubada. À medida que Faith tenta lidar com os seus complexos papéis de filha e detetive, os riscos aumentam mais do que nunca. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Will Trent T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Will investiga um homicídio com um padrão familiar, forçando-o a confrontar o seu passado enquanto segue um assassino que está sempre um passo à frente. À medida que o caso se desenrola, ele começa a suspeitar que a verdade está mais próxima – e mais pessoal – do que alguma vez imaginou. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Will Trent T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: No meio de uma tempestade tropical, o Departamento de Polícia de Atlanta e o Gabinete de Investigação da Geórgia correm contra o tempo para limpar o nome de um homem inocente, descobrindo segredos chocantes que sugerem que o assassino pode estar mais perto do que alguma vez pensaram. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem Toronto: Intenções Criminosas T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um esfaqueamento num skatepark leva Graff e Bateman a investigar uma complexa rede de fraudes no mercado imobiliário de Toronto. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Elsbeth T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando uma estudante universitária de Teatro é encontrada morta no seu apartamento num arranha-céus de Nova Iorque, Elsbeth suspeita imediatamente de mão criminosa e entra num jogo do gato e do rato com Alex Modarian, o famoso encenador que trabalhava com a vítima e que Elsbeth acreditar estar envolvido. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Be My Sunshine T1 - Ep. 78
programme.desc: Nehir já não quer sair com Okan. Biricik está feliz por receber a sua primeira encomenda. Zeynep recebe boas notícias do médico. Selma está chocada por ver um amigo de longa data. Biricik está em maus lençóis com a mãe de Beyazit. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Esquece-me Se Puderes (VO) T1 - Ep. 95
programme.desc: Musa e Ozan descobrem provas concretas contra Efe. Zümrüt vê Nazim com outra mulher. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Doce Mentira (VO) T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Ao aproximar-se o aniversário de Kayra, esta está convencida de que a mãe irá aparecer na sua festa. Nejat escreve uma carta para Kayra em nome da mãe mas acaba por não lha entregar. Suna é despedida do hotel onde trabalha. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Determinado a excluir Dixon, Travis discute a sua posição na corrida à presidência da câmara, e Maya admite ter feito chantagem. Entretanto, a equipa é chamada a um incêndio num complexo de apartamentos em ruínas que revela uma causa preocupante. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A equipa da Station 19 dá resposta a um acidente de viação no qual dois adolescentes ficam encarcerados num carro elétrico. Ben e Maya veem-se no meio de uma disputa doméstica que envolve um casal que odeiam. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Maya e Theo dão resposta a uma chamada numa festa de Halloween; a Station 19 recebe os miúdos do bairro para brincarem às “doçuras ou travessuras”; tem início uma guerra de partidas; Jack é assombrado por um fantasma do seu passado. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A equipa corre contra o tempo para resgatar um grupo de trabalhadores presos dentro de uma fábrica de reciclagem de baterias. Carina planeia uma surpresa especial na esperança de se reaproximar de Maya. Travis é apanhado na mira da política corrupta. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando uma trovoada faz despenhar um helicóptero, a equipa é dissuadida de organizar um boot camp para jovens. Ross, a comandante dos bombeiros, pede a Jack para ajudar na gestão. Os ânimos aquecem ainda mais entre Carina e Maya. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Station 19 T6 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Após um terrível relâmpago, a equipa da Station 19 faz horas extra para extinguir o incêndio em casa de Meredith Grey. Entretanto, Maya é levada para o Grey-Sloan Memorial Hospital devido a uma situação de emergência. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Art Of Us
programme.desc: Um passeador de cães com talento artístico escondido torna-se o foco dos planos de uma professora de História da Arte para impressionar os seus patrões numa exposição de arte. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Rancher 101 (Aka: The Movie Star And The Cowboy)
programme.desc: A história de Isabella, que consegue o seu papel de sonho como rancheira. O estúdio envia-a para viver num rancho para conhecer a realidade que irá representar, mas ela descobre que o rancheiro está demasiado ocupado a tentar salvar o seu rancho da ruína para a ajudar a realizar os seus sonhos. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Unidade Especial T20 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando uma série de assaltos a se torna mais violenta, a polícia investiga um grupo de celibatários involuntários para identificar um suspeito. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Unidade Especial T20 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um membro de um grupo pela emancipação feminina é encontrada morta, levando a polícia ao líder masculino carismático da organização. Entretanto, Rollins mantém a gravidez em segredo para evitar ter de fazer trabalho administrativo. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Unidade Especial T20 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Uma empregada de um restaurante nova-iorquino em voga é vítima de abuso sexual numa festa VIP pela noite dentro. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Lei & Ordem: Unidade Especial T20 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Stone leva o seu próprio caso a tribunal quando uma mulher do seu passado o acusa de abuso sexual. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: High Potential T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Quando uma pintura de valor inestimável é roubada num assalto a um museu, Morgan e Karadec unem-se a um especialista em recuperação de arte para desvendar um caso complicado e uma intensa disputa de propriedade. Entretanto, Soto está determinada a descobrir os segredos escondidos dentro da mochila de Roman. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Esquece-me Se Puderes T1 - Ep. 96
programme.desc: Esra tem um acidente a caminho da surpresa de Ozan, com consequências sérias e chocantes. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Doce Mentira T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Nejat sente-se responsável pelo mau comportamento de Kayra na escola. Suna embebeda-se e fica a dormir na casa de Nejat e Kayra vê-a dormir com o vestido que tinha comprado para a mãe. Nejat pede a Suna que finja ser a mãe de Kayra. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Anatomia de Grey T2 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Derek está zangado com Meredith, George voltou a casa e, apesar de ainda não se falarem, Meredith e Cristina começam o dia numa correria. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Anatomia de Grey T22 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Richard continua a lidar com a sua saúde; Meredith e Nick recebem a visita da irmã afastada de Nick, vinda de Boston. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Marine 2
programme.desc: Em férias, um sniper americano enfrenta rebeldes locais que assumiram o controlo de um resort onde ele e a esposa estão reféns. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Hitman - Agente 47
programme.desc: Abandonado pelo seu chefe misterioso e envolvido involuntariamente num assassinato político suspeito, um assassino furtivo apaixona-se por uma prostituta russa, que lhe complica a vida, antes de ele eliminar o seu inimigo. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Central de Inteligência
programme.desc: Após retomar contacto com um colega estranho do secundário através do Facebook, um contabilista pacífico é atraído para o mundo da espionagem internacional. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Só Podiam Ser Irmãs
programme.desc: Duas irmãs decidem dar uma última festa em casa antes de os pais venderem a moradia da família. Classificação etária: M/14.

programme.title: Eu, Tu e o Emplastro
programme.desc: Carl (Matt Dillon) e Molly (Kate Hudson) estão a começar as suas vidas como casal. Têm uma boa casa, empregos estáveis e uma vizinhança pacata. Neste mundo perfeito, só há uma falha - Dupree (Owen Wilson), o melhor amigo de Carl e um eterno solteirão. Dupree acaba de perder a casa e o emprego, e Carl decide convidá-lo a ficar no sofá durante uns dias... Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Má Vizinhança 2
programme.desc: A vida corre bem a Mac Radner (Seth Rogen) e à sua mulher Kelly (Rose Byrne), que está grávida, até que a fraternidade feminina Kappa Nu se muda para a casa do lado. Como as festas barulhentas ameaçam a venda da sua casa, o casal recorre ao ex-vizinho e ex-inimigo Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron) para obter ajuda. Classificação etária: M/14.

programme.title: Mil e Uma Maneiras de Bater as Botas
programme.desc: Um agricultor que se apaixona por uma mulher misteriosa recém-chegada à cidade terá de arranjar coragem quando o marido dela, um temido pistoleiro, aparece por aquelas bandas. Classificação etária: M/14.

programme.title: Horizontes Desconhecidos
programme.desc: Depois de comprarem o Louisiana a França, os EUA enviam os agrimensores Lewis e Clark, assistidos por um guia Shoshone, para cartografar o novo território. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Homem Solitário
programme.desc: Um pistoleiro deposita a sua esperança na confiança de uma mulher bonita que o esconde quando ele é acusado injustamente de um massacre numa diligência. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: 7 Homens Para Matar
programme.desc: A former sheriff blames himself for his wife's death during a Wells Fargo robbery and vows to track down and kill the seven men responsible.Um ex-Xerife culpa-se pela morte da mulher durante um assalto a uma Wells Fargo e jura encontrar e matar os sete homens responsáveis. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Cavaleiro Solitário
programme.desc: Jacob Wade, um velho pistoleiro, espera assentar com o seu filho afastado, mas os seus antigos inimigos têm outros planos para ele. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Pancadaria Chinesa
programme.desc: Thomas e David, proprietários de uma caravana de refeições rápidas, juntam-se a Moby, um detective privado, para tentarem salvar Sylvia, uma bela carteirsta. Acção e muita comédia num filme rodado na cidade de Barcelona. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: A Fúria do Dragão
programme.desc: Um jovem provinciano, lutador de artes marciais, visita os seus familiares em Roma, Itália, onde terá de os defender — a eles e ao restaurante do qual são proprietários — das ameaças de gangsters brutais. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Momento de Justiça 3
programme.desc: Um Reverendo da Igreja Baptista é assassinado por um gang numa pacata cidade no interior Americano. Tommy Lee (Phillip Rhee) está de visita à família quando também ele experiencia o ódio e a violência que consome a cidade. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Marine 3
programme.desc: Um Marine faz tudo para salvar a irmã, que foi raptada, e impedir um ataque terrorista orquestrado por um grupo militante radical. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Mozart - Mass in c minor, K. 427
programme.desc: This rendition of Mozart’s Mass in c minor, KV 427 by the Gächinger Kantorei Stuttgart, Bach-Collegium Stuttgart and conductor Helmuth Rilling is recorded at the Knights Hall in Schloss Wolfegg. Soloists are Ibolya Verebics, Andrea Rost, Uwe Heilmann and Daniel Lichti. After Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart had married Constanze Weber on the 4th of August 1782, he promised to compose a mass in her honour.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Messiaen a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sara Gouzy (France, 1991) and pianist Seri Dan (South Korea, 1992) perform ‘Chevaux de bois’ from Claude Debussy’s Ariettes oubliées, L. 63; Franz Schubert’s An den Mond, Op. 57, No. 3, D. 193; ‘Le collier’ from Olivier Messiaen’s Poèmes pour Mi; ‘Margaritki’ (Daisies) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; ‘Quelle aventure!

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 24, K 491
programme.desc: With sublimely beautiful music that supports, intensifies, and enhances the drama every step of the way, the Piano Concerto No. 24, K 491 is solid drama from start to finish, with a minor harmonic structure reminiscent of Don Giovanni. In this performance, recorded at Schönbrunn palace in Vienna, Andre Previn is the soloist and conductor of the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra.

programme.title: Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz.

programme.title: Bach - Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II No. 13 to 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Telemann - Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen, TWV 1:983
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Fomin plays Schumann, Beethoven and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: After a successful inaugural recital in 2016, pianist Misha Fomin returns to the stage in the intimate hall of the Concertgebouw Amsterdam on November 11, 2017. Celebrated by the local and international press for his natural virtuosity, the rich texture of his play and his great musical intelligence, Fomin interprets Fantasia, op. 17 by Schumann, Piano Sonata No. 30, op.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Festive Mozart Concert from Salzburg
programme.desc: This performance was recorded during Mozart Week on January 27, 2006 in Salzburg, Austria, at the Großes Festspielhaus (Large Festival House) in celebration of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 250th birthday. Under conductor Riccardo Muti, it features Thomas Hampson (baritone), Mitsuko Uchida (piano), Gidon Kremer (violin), Yuri Bashmet (viola), Wiener Singverein, and Wiener Philharmoniker. Pieces include Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Le Sacre: A ballet in two parts by Uwe Scholz
programme.desc: Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the 20th century, created two interpretations of Igor Stravinsky’s Le Sacre du Printemps for the Leipzig Ballet. Sacre I, for one dancer, can be interpreted as a bleak and oppressive dance about Scholz’ own life. This unique solo is performed by Giovanni Di Palma to the four-handed piano version.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Op. 61. The award-winning Isabelle Faust is the soloist, and since her recordings with Claudio Abbado, she’s the first choice when it comes to this masterpiece.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 13
programme.desc: The Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos' String Quartet No. 13. The quartet, existing of Carla Rincón (violin), Francisco Roa (violin), Fernando Thebaldi (viola) and Hugo Pilger (cello), was founded in 2006 and is specialised in Brazilian music and educational activities.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: BIRD
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. In this first broadcast we get to know Lisette Ma Neza (slam poet), Peter Somuah (trumpet), Michelle Samba (drums), Huy Le (bass), and Brenn Luiten (piano). Over the course of seven sessions, they exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Legendary Jazz
programme.desc: The term 'jam-session' was coined in the 1920s when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call 'jammin' the beat'.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 & 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Face au Public: Chuck Berry
programme.desc: No early breakthrough rock & roll artist is more important to the development of the genre than Chuck Berry (1926-2017). Influenced by jazz and rhythm and blues, he was rock & roll's greatest songwriter, the main shaper of its instrumental voice, one of its greatest guitarists, and one of its greatest performers.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is', recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Angel Forrest Show 2017
programme.desc: With a career of more than 30 years and 10 albums, Angel Forrest, recipient of the Maple Blues Awards for Female Vocalist of the Year for the las five years and finalist at the International Blues Challenge 2018 in Memphis, strikes again with Electric Love, a double live album. It was her tribute show to the legendary Janis Joplin that brought Angel Forrest to the public.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: De Beren Gieren
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seven Seas
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Mariana Aydar - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets & Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.desc: Num cenário pós-apocalítico, uma comunidade de rapazes descobre que está presa num labirinto misterioso. Juntos terão de descobrir como escapar, resolver o enigma e revelar o arrepiante segredo acerca de quem os colocou ali e por que razão.

programme.title: Fantasmas de Marte, de John Carpenter
programme.desc: 200 anos no futuro, uma unidade de polícia de Marte é destacada para transportar um perigoso prisioneiro de uma mina para prestar contas com a justiça.

programme.title: Momento da Verdade 3
programme.desc: Daniel e o seu adversário têm sede de vingança, mas o primeiro não tenciona voltar a combater. Apanhado numa cilada, é obrigado a voltar à luta..

programme.title: Monster Hunter
programme.desc: Atrás do nosso mundo existe um outro, governado por monstros com uma ferocidade mortal. Quando a tenente Artemis e a sua unidade são teletransportados para esse mundo novo, deparam-se com uma realidade para a qual não estavam preparados..

programme.title: Jonah Hex
programme.desc: Jonah Hex foi uma das várias vítimas do terrível Quentin Turnbull, um homem poderoso que lhe tirou tudo o que tinha. Por razões misteriosas, Hex, que deveria ter morrido, ressuscita com poderes sobrenaturais e vai fazer tudo para se vingar.

programme.title: Maze Runner: A Cura Mortal
programme.desc: Thomas lidera o grupo de Clareirenses na sua última e mais perigosa missão. Para salvar os amigos, eles devem invadir a lendária Última Cidade, um labirinto controlado pelo CRUEL que poderá ser o mais mortal de todos..

programme.title: Spartacus T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Spartacus lidera um ataque ousado para garantir alimento e abrigo para o seu povo. Crassus forma um exército temível e recebe uma visita inesperada.

programme.title: Instinto Animal 2
programme.desc: Uma divorciada tem flashbacks da sua vida enquanto, sem o saber, o seu vizinho do lado - um perito em segurança - implanta câmaras de vídeo por toda a casa para a espiar.

programme.title: A Margem
programme.desc: Durante uma viagem de negócios a Paris, Sigismond, um homem casado e aparentemente feliz, envolve-se com Diana, uma prostituta parecida com a sua esposa, enquanto recebe notícias trágicas que o levam ao desespero.

programme.title: Vícios Privados, Públicas Virtudes

programme.title: Anónimo T2 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Anónimo T2 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Anónimo T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Anónimo T2 - Ep. 4

programme.desc: Galadriel encontra um novo aliado. Elrond enfrenta uma receção fria de um velho amigo. Nori esforça-se por ajudar um Estranho. Arondir procura respostas enquanto Bronwyn alerta o seu povo sobre uma ameaça.

programme.desc: Chicago Fire T14 - Ep. 16
